summary: Select, Multiselect and DatePicker filled a disabled trigger with `bg-sunken`, a surface role standing in for a state, which ADR 0017 §3 forbids and which Input and Textarea dropped when that ADR landed. It only looked right because the two values happened to be close. When #24 moved the dark field ground, a disabled Select (#282522) and a disabled Input (#3d3a37) beside it stopped matching. All three triggers now take `bg-field-disabled`, Input's page-ground disabled fill. Light is unchanged, because sunken and field-disabled resolve to the same value there (#EDE8E3). Select's browser test asserts the disabled fill equals Input's in both schemes and fails against the old class.
